curriculum.course_title: Virginia Mathematics Standards of Learning, Grades 6-8
curriculum.note: Single VDOE 2023 SOL framework covering K-8 and high school; this inventory enumerates the Grade 6, 7, and 8 grade-level expectations only.

source_notes: The 2023 Mathematics Standards of Learning were approved by the Virginia Board of Education on 2023-08-31 and are fully implemented in SY 2024-2025.
Expectation identifiers follow the VDOE strand-coded scheme (e.g., 6.NS.1, 8.PFA.4); strands are NS, CE, MG, PS, and PFA.
Scope summaries are editorial paraphrases; reviewers must compare them with the official wording before accepting any mapping.
Each Grade 6–8 expectation now links to a VDOE 2023 Standards of Learning document; the instructional-resources page is support only, never source authority.

Strand-composite seeds (e.g., VA7.MG.GEOMETRY, VA7.PS.PROBABILITY) overlap several expectations partially and must not be treated as accepted coverage. Grade 8 has no repository seed rows at all.

classification_legend.standards_mapped: A repository-specific seed row partially overlaps this expectation; this does not mean the mapping is accepted or complete.
classification_legend.reviewed_skill: Independent mathematical approval must cover the exact atomic target and definition.
classification_legend.generator_available: A generator must target the exact reviewed identity; local content is not enough.
classification_legend.validated_practice: Practice must be independently validated against both expectation and skill scope.
classification_legend.assessment_ready: An accepted independent assessment contract must exist.
classification_legend.verified_mastery_evidence: Learner evidence is never inferred from mappings, generators, practice, or tests.
